null_structure.pooled_counts: Not reported. Draws of different nulls test different hypotheses on shared or fixed rows and are never pooled; there is no exceedance bound from a pooled draw count.

same_source_permutation_nulls.description: Relabelings of ONE Quaia realization: the same qualified Quaia rows (positions, proper motions, noise) with redshift-shell labels permuted within strata.

hypotheses.patch: z labels exchangeable within each NSIDE-2 patch
hypotheses.patch_gmag: exchangeable within patch x 8 G-quantile strata
hypotheses.patch_gmag_colour: exchangeable within patch x 4 G x 4 BP-RP strata

same_source_permutation_nulls.nesting: Patch-level exchangeability implies exchangeability within both refinements. patch x G8 and patch x G4 x BP-RP4 both refine patch x G4 (G4 edges are G8 edges; G4_edges_subset_of_G8_edges=True) but neither refines the other.
same_source_permutation_nulls.p_value_rule: (b+1)/(N+1) with b = draws >= observed is an exact conditional (Monte Carlo) permutation p-value for the stated within-stratum exchangeability of this one realization and a pre-specified statistic. The three nulls share one realization: their p-values are not independent evidence and are not combined.

complement_nulls.description: Relabelings of two FIXED Gaia-CRF3 complement samples; only the pseudo-shell labels are redrawn.
complement_nulls.why_no_p: Observed curvature comes from the Quaia rows; complement draws come from other fixed sources with other noise, so the observed value is not exchangeable with them. Rank only.

null_structure.post_selection: Spin was singled out after R104 saw these data (R104 RESULTS_KO.md sec. 3) among 11 statistics x 2 configurations x 2 jackknifes; permutation p-values for spin6 are conditional on that choice and are not corrected for it.

exclusion_selection.rule: Top delete-one shift-norm patch in curvature row 0, then the top patch in row 1 that differs from it, on the data set's own all-48 delete-one refits; shift norm over the sector variant's coefficients.
exclusion_selection.scope: The observed exclusion (8,47) is post-selected; each null draw applies the same rule to its own data. Ratio exceedances and excl_selected tables are selection-matched; the fixed-(8,47) values are a conditional diagnostic only.

idealized_hotelling_reference.scope: Idealized reference: p(n-1)/(n-p) F(p, n-p) for iid Gaussian patch contributions and a linear delete-one jackknife. NOT a calibration. Same-estimator null q95 / Hotelling q95 exceeds 1 in 135 of 180 null x configuration x jackknife x statistic cells (range 0.85-2.12), so reading observed values against it would be anti-conservative where the ratio exceeds 1.

numerical_convergence.statement: Replays and refits reproduce cached values; this certifies the arithmetic, not any scientific claim.

conditional_prediction.statement: Permutation p-values are conditional on one Quaia realization, on within-stratum z-exchangeability and on the post-selected statistic; the excluded-configuration and ratio results are conditional on the R104 selection rule applied per draw. Complement nulls give ranks only.

physical_attribution.statement: None. No null models AGIS scan, AGN-centroid or noise physics; physical_Pi and physical_GF are None. The per-source z-linear frame leak quantifies one frame-systematic pathway only.

interpretation_scope: Every null is a randomization of real catalogue rows through the identical estimator; none is an independent noise/AGIS-scan/AGN-centroid mock ensemble, so no significance or calibrated p is produced. Permutation nulls test within-stratum z-exchangeability of one realization and get an exact conditional permutation p per null; complement nulls use disjoint fixed sources and get ranks only; nulls are never pooled. The excluded configuration is selection-matched per draw.
